products.name: Royal Velvet Celebration Box
products.description: Our signature flagship festival hamper containing 35 hand-picked varieties: aerial repeaters, golden flower pots, spinning chakkars, sparklers, and novelty fireworks packed in royal velvet luxury packaging.
products.safetyInfo: Follow individual item instructions inside. Open outdoor space recommended.

products.name: Celestial 25-Shot Aerial Cake
products.description: Spectacular multi-shot aerial barrage launching 25 timed bursts with golden crackling palms and electric purple dahlias reaching up to 120 feet.
products.safetyInfo: Place on hard, level ground. Minimum 25-meter clearance from buildings.

products.name: Imperial Golden Fountain (Pack of 5)
products.description: Towering cone fountains projecting an 8-foot curtain of golden titanium sparks transitioning into lavender pearls and crackling silver willows.
products.safetyInfo: Light fuse at arm's length. Keep bucket of water and sand ready.

products.name: Cyclone Spinner Ground Chakkars
products.description: High-velocity rotating wheels that spin vigorously on flat pavement creating hypnotic concentric circles of emerald green and golden sparks.
products.safetyInfo: Light only on smooth flat ground. Never ignite on grass or loose sand.

products.name: Electric Violet & Gold Sparklers (15 cm)
products.description: Low-smoke, long-duration handheld festival sparklers producing vibrant violet sparks followed by warm golden crackles for festive family evenings.
products.safetyInfo: Adult supervision required. Extinguish immediately in a bucket of water.

products.name: Titan Whistling Altitude Rockets
products.description: High-thrust aerodynamic celebration rockets that ascend with an intense sonic whistle before bursting into a multi-colored peony at the peak.
products.safetyInfo: Launch only from a dedicated rocket launch tube. Never hold in hand.
